card.name: The start of words beginning with pro
card.fires_on: The word-start piece 'pro' or 'Pro' (also 'pr' after a period) at the beginning of a longer word, such as provides, produce, prothrombin, protective, proton. It fires in both lowercase and all-caps text.

modes.label: All-caps label text
modes.description: Capitalised 'PRO' starting a long word in uppercase warnings.

modes.label: Ordinary prose
modes.description: Lowercase 'pro' or 'pr' starting a word in running text.
modes.example: The white background <<pro>>vides good contrast for seeing the darker macro

modes.label: Sentence-initial Pro
modes.description: 'Pro' opening a sentence, as in proton pump inhibitors.

card.writes: It pushes toward prop-type continuations and away from other short endings like op or ps.
card.plain: It marks a word that has just begun with the letters pro and is not yet finished.
